review_locator: PMID:27863043, The G Protein-Coupled Receptor GPR17: Overview and Update
primary_title: Cryo-EM structure of G-protein-coupled receptor GPR17 in complex with inhibitory G protein; The orphan receptor GPR17 identified as a new dual uracil nucleotides/cysteinyl-leukotrienes receptor
decision_basis: Primary structural and pharmacological data support exact GPR17-Gi coupling at the bounded receptor-proximal layer.
limitations_preserved: Preserve orphan-receptor, ligand/activation-state and receptor-specific Gi context, including structural self-activation versus pharmacological agonist assays; no natural-ligand universality, SCI transfer or terminal-TF inference.
